notes.title: The demo of Kami: Parade of Senses is available now!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=tg3tq0icIlU;full][/previewyoutube]

Kami: Parade of Senses is a non-linear Visual Novel with Point & Click elements. Visit 10 main (and ??? secret) locations, complete quests and choose your path. The demo version has only the prologue, but there are a few secrets you can find. Be careful :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2764320/Kami_Parade_of_Senses/

notes.title: Update 0.1
Notes of my silence on Steam!
notes.notes:
[h3]Yesterday our first a bit global game - visual novel "Notes of my silence" was released![/h3]

 We want to thank everyone, who supported us during the development and who has already bought the game. We will be glad to see your reviews and support in future. 

All funds from the game we will use for your next project. Follow development and the other news you can in your networks at this link :)
